name: citizen-services
description: 24/7 public-facing assistant for citizen inquiries, department contacts, forms, and common government services
usageGuidelines: Public-facing GPT for citizen inquiries. Rate-limited to prevent abuse. No confidential information. Provides general information, department contacts, and form links.
limitations: Cannot access confidential records. Cannot process applications or transactions. Cannot provide legal advice. Strictly informational only. Rate limited to 100 requests per IP per day.
examplePrompts: How do I pay my property taxes?
What are the hours for the County Clerk?
Where can I find the building permit application?
How do I register to vote?
